_comment: Hand-labelled outputs and the terms a mapper should find for them (ADR 0011). Query text is what the mapping stage embeds: name, description, type, a few observed values.

cases.query: lot no. The batch identifier, text, e.g. G17230211
use by. When the batch expires, date, 2025-03-31
made on. Date the batch was manufactured
manufacturer. The company that made the product, e.g. Acme Pharma Ltd
product. Medicinal product name, e.g. Richfer capsules
complies. Whether the result passes, boolean, Complies
released by. Person who signed the record
lot. One manufacturing run of a product
